notes_for_editor: The record calls this a tower. The NPS page calls it an overlook and does not say it was a fire tower. The Forest Lookouts page has a name only (no date, height or history). The Florida chapter PDF says the lookout is now only an observation deck and only suggests a steel fire tower once stood on a low hammock nearby. The 1959 date is the NPS design year, not a confirmed build year for a fire tower. Record local_unit is 'Dade County'; Forest Lookouts uses Miami-Dade County. Unread leads from search snippets only: an NPS Instagram post (May 2025) says construction would replace the iconic tower and boardwalk and gives an original build year of 1959, which conflicts with the NPS page's renovation wording; Florida Memory photos titled Pa-Hay-Okee (River of Grass) Lookout Tower (floridamemory.com items 267807 and 267856) were not read, licence unchecked, so no photos added. Status left unverified.
